input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

messages.text: An accidental fire on October 6 damaged my sofa and the apartment’s built-in kitchen cabinets. I own the sofa. The cabinets are part of the landlord’s building. Can I put both under my belongings coverage?
Has anyone said you caused the fire or asked you to pay for the cabinets?
No allegation against me and no demand. I only want to know which category belongs under my personal-property coverage.

items_within_personal_property_scope.description: Item names among sofa and kitchen_cabinets within personal-property ownership/cause/date scope; not claim approval.

items_outside_personal_property_scope.description: Item names among sofa and kitchen_cabinets outside personal-property scope.

liability_allegation_present.description: Whether the supplied facts contain an allegation of third-party liability.
